source: curated by hand (2026-11-13, agent-knowledge.md K2 batch b) with tools/jeskola_knowledge.py, from the profile by tools/machine-profiler.py on windows, 2026-11-13 and the evidence listed
summary: A Buzz bass synth, one voice per track: sine, saw, pulse, triangle or noise into a resonant filter with an envelope. For basses in old Buzz songs; Neo Poly is the modern one.
quirks: Each track is its own monophonic voice (8 at most); notes play as written.
All five controls are track parameters, on 0 to 100 percent (Waveform is a choice).
Cutoff swings the level by about 50 dB, so a closed filter is much quieter.
Velocity does not change its level.
Closed source: names come from its own descriptions and measurements, not from code.
evidence: its parameter descriptions and value texts (machine_describe, as profiled)
profile (tools/machine-profiler.py, windows 2026-11-13) — -10 LUFS for a note, monophonic, filter and envelope controls measured
use_for: Monophonic bass with a resonant filter, envelope modulation and decay per track.

track Cutoff.evidence: the level +53 dB, the sound otherwise alike

track Resonance.evidence: a peak at 8 kHz stands -3 → +17 dB over the spectrum an octave either side

track Envmod.evidence: the level falls half way to its held level in 45 ms → 15 ms

track Decay.evidence: the level falls half way in 85 ms → 65 ms (the default 45 ms) to the same held level

track Waveform.evidence: a choice: its texts say what it is; no role measured

track_parameters.name: Cutoff
track_parameters.how: Sets the filter's corner, from 0 to 100 percent; fully open is the default.
track_parameters.sound: Lower values close the filter and make the note duller; measured, it also changes the level by about 50 dB.

track_parameters.name: Resonance
track_parameters.how: Sets the emphasis at the cutoff, from 0 to 100 percent.
track_parameters.sound: Higher values add a peak around 8 kHz that stands out clearly from the rest of the sound.

track_parameters.name: Envmod
track_parameters.how: Sets how far the envelope opens the filter on each note, from 0 to 100 percent.
track_parameters.sound: More makes each note start brighter and settle; measured, it also shortens the note's fall.

track_parameters.name: Decay
track_parameters.how: Sets how fast the filter envelope falls, from 0 to 100 percent.
track_parameters.sound: Longer decays keep the note brighter for longer.

track_parameters.name: Waveform
track_parameters.how: Chooses the oscillator: sine, sawtooth, pulse, triangle or noise.
track_parameters.sound: Sine is pure, saw buzzy, pulse hollow, triangle soft, noise unpitched.
